method: Built-in image_gen; original painted sources, no external artwork.
brief: docs/SPRITE_ART_DIRECTION.md: Style and setting; sprite continuity. Mechanical crop/resize only; original alpha and artwork retained.

assets.name: soap
assets.prompt: Use case: game-asset. Create one original inventory sprite for Caelum Argenteum, a dark fantasy RPG inspired by nineteenth-century Argentina. Subject: a single handmade laundry soap bar made of animal fat, pale warm ivory/beige, roughly cut rectangular block with gently uneven edges, faint knife marks and a small dry crack. Unwrapped, no logo, no lettering. Painted pixel-oriented old-school game sprite, bold readable silhouette, modest hand-painted shading and material texture, soft light from upper left, restrained earth palette. Three-quarter view slightly from above, centered, isolated, fills most of the square with safe margins. Must read clearly after scaling to a 128px inventory icon. No glossy 3D-render look, no photographic realism, no black outlines, no bubbles, no hands, no floor or scene, no decorative accessories, no watermark. Actual transparent alpha background.
